name: Meddlesome Mages

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see the danger in the High Order's reckless spellcasting. Their apprentices disregard the delicate balance that holds the island together.

faq.answer: You are asked to drive away High Order Apprentices gathered at sacred standing stones north of the village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
faq.q: What is the quest Meddlesome Mages about?

aliases: who are the high order apprentices
faq.answer: The High Order is a faction of mages whose apprentices have ignored warnings and intruded on sacred ground to experiment with magic. The locals regard them as shen'dorei brothers and sisters.
faq.q: Who are the High Order Apprentices?

faq.answer: The apprentices have ignored repeated warnings to avoid the standing stones. Their reckless spellcraft threatens the fragile forces binding the island and could bring destruction to the homeland.
faq.q: Why must the High Order Apprentices be dispersed?

faq.answer: The High Order Apprentices gather at standing stones north of the village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
faq.q: Where are the High Order Apprentices gathering?

faq.answer: The shen'dorei are kin to the people who ask for help. Conflict among their own people weighs on the local leaders, yet they feel compelled to act against the High Order to protect their homeland.
faq.q: Who are the shen'dorei mentioned in the quest?

aliases: what could happen to the island
faq.answer: Delicate forces bind the island together, and they are vulnerable. Unchecked arcane meddling could break them and destroy the island.
faq.q: What danger do the mages pose to the island?

sections.body: North of the village, High Order apprentices gather around ancient standing stones. Repeated warnings have not turned them from the sacred sites. They press on with their arcane studies, while local leaders hesitate to shed the blood of their shen'dorei kin. So they call for outside help to drive the apprentices away before lasting harm is done.
sections.title: Encroachment at the Stones

sections.body: Delicate mystical forces bind the island's land together and keep it safe. The defenders fear the High Order gives little thought to the danger in its spellcraft. One careless spell could break those bindings. Then ruin would come to everyone who lives there.
sections.title: The Fragile Island

summary: In the Shen'dar Highlands, High Order apprentices gather at sacred stones and meddle with magic. Their spells threaten the fragile forces that hold the island together.
